name: Blocker Tiles
description:
The cells that do not play along. A blocker occupies a board position and refuses something the ordinary rules allow: a wall cannot be swapped or fallen through, ice freezes the piece under it until a match breaks the ice rather than the piece, and a crate is cleared only by a match that lands NEXT to it because it holds no piece of its own. Those three are one component because they differ by two declared flags -- whether the cell holds a piece and whether it blocks a fall -- and splitting them into three would triple the wiring for no new idea.

Layers are what make a blocker a puzzle rather than an obstacle: a two-layer ice clears to one-layer ice and reports the step, so the board can show progress toward something that has not happened yet. That is also why clearing is an event rather than a silent decrement -- an objective counting ice needs to hear each layer, not just the final one.

The component owns which cells are blocked and how much life each has. It owns no matching: world.match_resolver decides what cleared and where, and this decides what that did to the furniture.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: blockers
inputs.description: Placed blockers: position, kind, layers, and whether the cell holds a piece and blocks a fall. Required -- the layout is the level, and a default would be a board somebody else designed.

inputs.name: clearedByAdjacent
inputs.description: Kinds cleared by a match landing beside them rather than on them. A crate holds no piece, so nothing can ever match on it.

inputs.name: blocksFall
inputs.description: Kinds a falling piece cannot pass through. This is what makes a board with holes in it behave like a board with holes in it.

inputs.name: spreadEnabled
inputs.description: Whether an unchecked blocker grows into a neighbouring cell each turn. Off by default: spreading is a difficulty spike that should be asked for.

outputs.name: blockedCells
outputs.description: Positions currently occupied by a blocker.

outputs.name: remaining
outputs.description: Blockers still standing, for an objective to count.
